scripts.lighthouse:local: CHROME_PATH=$(which google-chrome 2>/dev/null || which chromium-browser 2>/dev/null || which chromium 2>/dev/null || echo '') && if [ -n "$CHROME_PATH" ]; then mkdir -p reports && npx lighthouse https://kalmate.pages.dev --output=html --output-path=./reports/lighthouse-local --chrome-path="$CHROME_PATH" --chrome-flags='--headless=new --no-sandbox --disable-gpu' && echo 'Report: reports/lighthouse-local.html'; else echo 'Chrome not found. Install Chrome or Chromium to run Lighthouse locally.'; fi
